name: Wishing Star
doc: Wishing Star (Rinoa's limit break): the director's 0x10F-tick timeline - Rinoa riding Angelo up into a starry sky, the screen shattered and falling, the stars twinkling, Angelo diving through the targets eight times (eight damage waves) under a rain of sparkles, the landing, the white fade; the camera all along. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag089_wishing_star.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the magic buffer); no file loader (its TIMs are exe data).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: Its 0x10F-tick timeline: Rinoa and Angelo rising, the screen shattered, the starry sky, eight dives and damage waves under the sparkles, the landing, the white fade; the camera all along
